meta.title: More decimal places than the template allows are rounded visibly
gaps: Independently verify that the rounded displayed value and the backend-stored unsent value agree.
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`
can only test part of this — no step for: Independently verify that the rounded displayed value and the backend-stored unsent value agree.

steps.note: Open the multi-stage create flow for an RFQ pricing sheet.
Configure the event with an RFQ stage so a pricing template and price cell are available.
Move to the RFQ stage before configuring its sheet.
Apply the first available pricing template, whose decimal precision controls the rounding behavior.
Add one line item so the pricing sheet renders a price cell.
Populate the sheet prerequisites before editing the price cell.
Enter the value with more decimal places than the configured two-decimal precision.
Verify that the price is visibly rounded to 101.00 before submission.
